dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with irregular, jagged perimeters. The gradient transition from the dark exterior to the lighter interior is sharp, with the most distinct geometries appearing as elongated ovoids in the central-left and upper-mid sections.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, solid light-toned pixel clusters lacking internal gradients. These are concentrated most heavily in the lower-left and mid-right regions, often filling the interstitial spaces between the larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the center-top region form an obtuse scalene triangle. A secondary cluster of smaller blobs in the lower-right forms a roughly linear arrangement.
